notes: Visual row-family audit of all eight uploaded PDFs. This is not a verbatim transcription of brand/model names.
Printed quantities are observations only and are NEVER used as 6/7/8-stop quantities. PDF amounts are in rial, workbook prices in toman.
18948 filename says five stops and eight persons; its floor-door/button quantities are eight. Do not infer a capacity multiplier or a new stop count from this conflict.
Workbook units/models may differ from PDF models (notably M011). ProductId means corresponding equipment family, not a certified interchangeable model.

1405/08/10: invoices 17784 (full automatic, now 58 rows incl. the all-steel cabin) and 19381 (full semi-automatic, 60 rows; replaces 15533) are the client's newest lists. They supersede 17784/15533 and define the row ORDER: mechanic, startup, doors/motor/controller, rail. The older 15527/15528/15529/15530/18948/19040 files remain as evidence of the family sets only.

The newest semi-automatic list has no mechanical cam (P-SEMI-CAM, present in older semi files 15529/15533/19040). It is retired from the package rules. The client asked for the all-steel cabin (P-STEEL-CABIN) as the last row of EVERY package, including those whose PDF does not print it.

1405/08/10 (r2): motors are 6.1 kW (4-6 persons) and 7.3 kW (8 persons) with brands Behran/Elco/ABB; the controller is 7.5 kW (4-6) or 11 kW (8) with brands Datis/Paya/Aryan. Evidence rows were renamed P-MOTOR-7.5 -> P-MOTOR-6.1 and P-MOTOR-11 -> P-MOTOR-7.3 (the printed 'Behran 6/1KW' is 6.1 kW). Invoice 18948 is another customer's order with different quantities; it is NOT used for 8-person quantities.
